title: Elves Look, Elves Say
description: Apply the look-and-say transformation repeatedly and measure the result length.
writeup:
## Approach

The look-and-say (or Conway) sequence replaces each run of identical digits with the run length followed by the digit. There's no shortcut needed here — just simulate it directly.

## Part 1

Apply the transformation 40 times to the puzzle input and return the length of the resulting string. Building the new string with a list of chunks and joining at the end keeps it efficient.

## Part 2

Apply the transformation 50 times total (10 more after Part 1). The string grows roughly by a factor of 1.3 each iteration (Conway's constant λ ≈ 1.304), so after 50 steps it's in the millions of characters — still fast enough with straightforward iteration.
